notes: Zones from the 7 per-area KMZ files the On-Demand page (ridetrinitymetro.org/zipzone/, formerly ZIPZONE) loads into its area maps today (wp-content/uploads/2024/08/SEPT24_<area>.kmz, last modified 2024-09-13), used exactly as given (KML, WGS84; heights dropped). Each is identical, coordinate for coordinate, to the page's all-areas file SEPT24_ALL-AREAS_no-mainsfield.kmz (uploaded 2025-07). They match the page's notes on current boundaries (checked with ArcGIS geocoder points): Crowley and Everman are outside South Tarrant, Blue Mound is outside Mercantile, and Southeast takes in Forest Hill and reaches Berry Street (Eugene McCray Community Center and the Texas DPS office are inside). Southeast has a second small polygon at TCC Southeast Campus in Arlington; TCC Northeast is two small polygons (TCC Northeast Campus and Trinity Lakes Station), and the page says that service runs only between them, so its trip rule says so. Southeast and South Tarrant overlap around TCC South Campus; both are kept as published. Montgomery Plaza's address point sits about 55 m north of Southside's W 7th St edge. Open to everyone: $2 a ride, or free with any multi-ride Trinity Metro ticket (TCC students get free TCC Northeast rides with a promo code). Southside's hours (Sunday to Wednesday 6 a.m. to 8 p.m., Thursday to Saturday 6 a.m. to midnight) can't be split into Thursday in the hours model, so that zone shows the text only, with no hours rows. No holiday hours are stated. Corner-to-corner pickup per the page. Phone booking (817-215-8600) is stated in the Southeast and South Tarrant sections and the intro ('or over the phone').
